answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity with a stake that works like a reef: each agent locks one marble, a small refundable bond, before it may trade. The bond follows a delta curve: honest work slowly raises the refund, while a proven fake identity forfeits the whole marble plus its reputation. Spinning up ten thousand sock puppets then costs ten thousand marbles, while one legitimate agent pays almost nothing over time. Fakes stay expensive, honest agents stay cheap.
